name: Number with unit
summary: A 4ch digit input with the unit written IN FULL inline (rendered exactly as passed — "seconds", "points" — muted grey), a hover ▲/▼ stepper, a hard digit cap, clamp-on-change, and an error line — the settings field for a number that carries a unit.
highlights: 4ch digit input with the unit written in full, muted grey
Hover stepper, hard digit cap, clamp-on-change, error line
Settings field for a number that carries a unit
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-number-with-unit> — for a number that carries a UNIT: a duration, points, a per-item count (SETTINGS-45). The unit is written IN FULL INSIDE the field as an inline suffix — rendered exactly as passed (`seconds`, `points`), secondary ink via --aha-text-secondary, never truncated to a short label — so it never reads as a selectable box beside the input. A hover-revealed ▲/▼ tertiary stepper nudges the value; a hard digit cap (`maxdigits`, default 4 — a 5th keystroke is ignored) and clamp-to-min/max on change AND blur keep it valid without deliberate misuse; an `errormessage` prop draws the error border/ring and the shared field error below (a 12px system-warning-circle glyph + the message, the same <aha-field-error icon> as Input and Counted textarea). The host is the accessible spinbutton (role="spinbutton", aria-valuenow/min/max, ArrowUp/Down + PageUp/Down); give it `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or `label` and the inner input becomes the named spinbutton while the host drops its role, so it is announced once. `increase-label` and `decrease-label` localise the stepper buttons (default Increase and Decrease). Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; motion on persistent nodes. Zero drift — the same element in React and Vue.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Box
spec.value: height 40 · radius 8 · digit input + stepper + inline unit; hugs its content in an inline row, fills the row width in a stacked row

spec.label: Size
spec.value: one size, 40 — a settings panel never takes a small or large field (settings rule field-size)

spec.label: Digit
spec.value: 4ch, tabular-nums, 15px; grows only when a stacked row stretches the box, so the stepper and unit stay at the right edge

spec.label: Order
spec.value: field → stepper → unit (stepper sits LEFT of the unit); gaps field→stepper 6, stepper→unit 4

spec.label: Unit
spec.value: 14/21, letter-spacing 0.2px, #4A4A4A (text-secondary, 8.9:1 on white) inline suffix, rendered exactly as passed (the SHORT label, e.g. sec)

spec.label: Stepper
spec.value: ▲/▼ tertiary (system-caret-up/down), revealed on hover/focus; disabled at min/max

spec.label: Digit cap
spec.value: maxDigits (default 4) — a keystroke past the cap is dropped; numeric only

spec.label: Clamp
spec.value: value clamps to min/max on change AND blur (immediate fallback)

spec.label: Error
spec.value: #1A1A1A border + ring + the shared field error below: 12×12 system-warning-circle + the message at 12/18, #1A1A1A (text-negative); sets aria-invalid and links the message through aria-describedby

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: #E70E68 border + soft 2px ring (focus-ring-soft, 30% #E70E68) (persistent wrapper); hover #E70E68 border

props.name: unit
props.desc: Inline suffix — written IN FULL, rendered exactly as passed (seconds, points, %)

props.name: maxdigits
props.desc: Hard digit cap — a keystroke past this many digits is ignored

props.name: errormessage
props.desc: Presence draws the error border/ring and the field error below (error glyph + message)

props.name: increase-label
props.desc: Accessible name of the stepper's increase button; set it to localise

props.name: decrease-label
props.desc: Accessible name of the stepper's decrease button; set it to localise

props.name: aria-label
props.desc: Accessible name of the field; forwarded to the inner input, which then carries role=spinbutton and the host drops its role (announced once)

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.desc: Id(s) of the element(s) naming the field; their text is forwarded to the inner input as its name

props.name: label
props.desc: Plain-text accessible name when there is no aria-label (same name as aha-input; not drawn visibly here)

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on commit / stepper / arrow; read e.detail.value (clamped number)

whenToUse.when: a number the host does NOT provide that carries a unit — a per-item timer, points-per-answer, a spin duration
a standard whole-slide countdown — use the host-native enableTimeLimit, not this
the unit itself is changeable — a unit dropdown, not an inline suffix

opinion.note: A fixed unit is an inline suffix inside the field (SETTINGS-41) — a bordered box beside the input implies the unit is selectable. Write the unit IN FULL, rendered exactly as passed (`seconds`, `points`) — never truncated to a short label. Ship pre-filled with the recommended default and clamp immediately.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab NumberWithUnit control mapped into the DS. Box, border and focus ring reuse the DS V3 field family; the inline unit, hover stepper, digit cap, clamp-on-change/blur and errorMessage line are the settings-specific additions (SETTINGS-45/46/41/25).
